[매터 감마 : 공격력 {1}% ▲] [지속] [전투 중 1회 발동]

[시전자의 최종 최대 체력 비례 {2}% 회복]

text.en:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. 
Metal γ: ATK ▲ {1}% continuously. Activates once per battle.
■ Activates when in Metal γ status after performing 10 normal attacks. Affects all allies.
Restores HP equal to {2}% of the skill user's final max HP.
■ Activates if the skill user is in Metal γ status when an ally is out of action. Affects {3} incapacitated ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK (except the skill user).
Resurrect with {4}% HP.
■ Activates when an ally is out of action. Affects self.
Removes Metal γ.

[차지 시간 {7}초 ▼] [{8}초 유지]

■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.

■ Activates when entering Full Burst while in the Metal σ state. Affects self.

ATK ▲ {4}% for {5} sec.
Removes Metal σ.
■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects the {6} ally unit(s) with the longest base Charge Time.
Charge Time ▼ {7} sec for {8} sec.

Metal σ: Burst Gauge filling speed ▲ {1}% continuously.
